title: Single-row test-run observation writer republishes the in-use revision when revision allocation fails
outcome: Single-row test-run observation writer republishes the in-use revision when revision allocation fails
acceptance: persist_test_command_observation_locked publishes its TestRunChanged only at a revision its commit actually allocated (the same before/after guard as the batch path), and publishes nothing when allocation fails; its persistence and failed-tracking behaviour are otherwise unchanged.

A regression with inner.revision = u64::MAX shows no delta at the reused revision while the observation is still tracked as failed; the review pair finds no Medium or higher and the full gate passes on the exact landed tree.
